title: Myrmex Planning Result v1
description: A planning result is a proposal only. It is not plan activation authority, not human authority, not Frontier validation authority, and not commit, delivery, merge, release, or deployment authority. It never authorizes repository effects; the authority block pins every authorization flag to false. Canonical digest rules: result_digest is the canonical SHA-256 digest of the complete result envelope (all fields except result_digest itself) using UTF-8, LF line endings, deterministic key ordering for structured fields, and no insignificant trailing whitespace.

request_id.description: Exact planning request identity this result answers.

plan_revision.description: Embedded plan revision (see plan-revision-v1.schema.json). For plan responses the embedded lifecycle_status must be proposed and the envelope identity must equal the revision identity; null for other response types.

clarification.description: Strict blocking clarification for response_type blocking_clarification; null otherwise.

completion_evidence.description: Evidence of already-complete state; empty for plan and blocking_clarification responses, non-empty for already_complete responses (enforced by plan semantics).

authority.description: A planning result is a proposal only: it does not activate plans, grant human/Frontier authority, authorize repository writes or commits, or trigger delivery, merge, release, or deployment.

result_digest.description: Canonical SHA-256 digest of the complete result envelope (all fields except result_digest itself).
